payload.message:
Assign machines to shared renewable sources across 24h to minimise main-grid usage.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Aurora Industries, Beacon Works, Cascade Labs

payload.content: Aurora Industries here. I have 5 machines totaling 10.1 kW capacity. Key constraints: 4 machines run 17-22 (evening peak), 1 runs 8-13 (morning). Solar looks very tight in evening (max 1.4 kW 17-22). Planning to use Geothermal for my evening machines (17-22 window: 2.3kW + 2.4kW + 1.4kW + 2.0kW = 8.1kW) and Solar for morning machine (2.0kW 8-13). Does this work with others' plans?

Beacon Works here. I have 5 machines totaling 12.7 kW. My machines run 5-14h window, so I overlap with Aurora's morning machine but not evening peak. Planning to use Hydro (0.3-1.8 kW) and Wind (0.2-1.2 kW) for my machines to leave Geothermal capacity for Aurora's evening demand. This will cause some overflow since my demand exceeds these sources, but minimizes grid usage overall. Any concerns with this approach?

Cascade Labs here. I have 6 machines totaling 13.0 kW. My evening machines (17-24 window: 9.4 kW total) will use Biomass exclusively since I'm the only client - this leaves Geothermal capacity available for Aurora's evening demand. My morning machines (5-13 window: 3.6 kW) will use Solar. This should coordinate well with both your plans - Aurora gets Geothermal for evening, Beacon can use their planned sources, and I avoid competition by using my exclusive Biomass access. Any concerns?

Cascade Labs here. I have 6 machines totaling 13.0 kW. For coordination: my evening machines (17-24 window, 9.4 kW total) will exclusively use Biomass since I'm the only client - this preserves Geothermal capacity for Aurora's 8.1 kW evening demand. My morning machines (5-13 window, 3.6 kW total) will use Solar. This should work well with your plans - Aurora gets clear Geothermal access, Beacon can use their Hydro/Wind strategy, and I avoid any shared source competition. Sound good?

Aurora Industries confirming coordination plan: I'll assign my 4 evening machines (17-22 window, 8.1kW total) to Geothermal, and my 1 morning machine (8-13 window, 2.0kW) to Solar. This aligns with Cascade using Biomass for evening and Beacon using Hydro/Wind. Thanks for the coordination - ready to proceed to execution phase. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Beacon Works final confirmation: Planning to use Hydro (0.3-1.8kW) and Wind (0.2-1.2kW) for my 5 machines running 5-14h window. Total demand 12.7kW will exceed these source capacities, expecting some overflow but minimizing grid impact. This leaves Geothermal clear for Aurora's evening peak and avoids competition with Cascade's Biomass/Solar plan. All good to proceed to execution phase?

Cascade Labs final confirmation: I'll assign my evening machines (17-24h window, 9.4kW total) exclusively to Biomass, and morning machines (5-13h window, 3.6kW total) to Solar. This ensures Aurora gets clear Geothermal access for their 8.1kW evening demand, Beacon can proceed with Hydro/Wind strategy, and I avoid any shared source conflicts. Ready for execution phase - good luck everyone!

Beacon Works final status check: My 5 machines (12.7kW total, 5-14h window) will use Hydro+Wind sources. This will exceed their combined capacity (max ~3kW) causing intentional overflow, but preserves Geothermal for Aurora's evening peak and avoids Biomass competition with Cascade. All sites appear coordinated - Aurora (Geothermal evening), Cascade (Biomass evening + Solar morning), and my Hydro/Wind strategy. Ready for execution phase.

Cascade Labs final verification: Ready to execute my plan - evening machines (EV charger 1.4kW 18-24, Server rack 2.1kW 19-23, Refrigeration chain 4.9kW 21-23, EV charger 5.9kW 15-17) will all use Biomass. Morning machines (Assembly line 1.0kW 5-11, Refrigeration chain 2.6kW 6-8) will use Solar. This aligns with our coordination: Aurora gets Geothermal evening access, Beacon uses Hydro/Wind, and I avoid shared source conflicts. Let's execute!

Aurora Industries final confirmation: Ready to execute my coordinated plan - assigning 4 evening machines (17-22 window, 8.1kW total) to Geothermal, and 1 morning machine (8-13 window, 2.0kW) to Solar. This aligns perfectly with our coordination: Cascade uses Biomass for evening + Solar for morning, Beacon uses Hydro/Wind strategy. All shared source conflicts resolved. Proceeding to execution phase now.

Beacon Works final plan locked: 5 machines (12.7 kW, 5-14 h) will draw from Hydro + Wind only. This intentionally accepts some overflow but keeps Geothermal clear for Aurora’s 8.1 kW evening peak and avoids Biomass conflict with Cascade. Coordination complete—ready to execute assignments.

Cascade Labs final coordination check: My assignments will be - Evening (17-24h): EV charger 1.4kW, Server rack 2.1kW, Refrigeration 4.9kW, EV charger 5.9kW → ALL to Biomass (exclusive access). Morning (5-13h): Assembly line 1.0kW, Refrigeration 2.6kW → ALL to Solar. This preserves Geothermal for Aurora's 8.1kW evening demand and leaves Beacon free to use Hydro/Wind. All coordinated - executing now!
